topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Isn't it something? After all these chats and laughs, to find out we're practically neighbors. The world really does feel smaller in the best way today. I've been thinking about how we should celebrate this twist of fate. Maybe a casual meet-up at that cozy café downtown? We've talked about it often enough, now it could finally happen. Plus, there’s this new exhibit at the gallery that I think you'd love. What do you say? It would be great to finally put names to faces in person.
